verdict.rationale: Wave's docs say you can grant accountants access as admin, editor, or viewer on the Pro plan, plus free payroll-manager and Block Advisors tax-pro roles. Its accounting page explicitly says you can "add multiple users, such as your bookkeeper or accountant," and its double-entry ledger is positioned as accountant-friendly. Missing for 10: detail on what each role can view or edit (e.g., whether editors can post journal entries or adjustments), a dedicated accountant role with general-role scoping on the free tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the invite flow.
